summary.headline: Your newsletter assistant is built and testing. Four account fixes are still open, and we are closing them this week.
summary.body: Done so far: your logins and links use your own domain, the time zone is Eastern, and the website loads at www.flretirementsolutions.com. Your new newsletter assistant is working inside GHL and wrote its first test issue today. Your clients, leads and notes move into GHL by tomorrow, Fri Oct 30. Still open: the website without the www, domain auto-renew and business texting registration.
summary.needs_you: Pick which recorded video becomes your free agent training, and send the recordings you haven't published yet.
summary.next_call: Today, Thu Oct 29 at 3 PM ET (2 PM CT). Weekly after that.
